Prices are the router's card list prices (app/routing/data/prior_cards.json, per M tokens), used for cost whatever the free tier charges. gpt-oss-120b: General Compute sometimes cannot parse its tool calls deep in a run (HTTP 400); the step agent retries those with some sampling variation. claude: the open models run inside lean Claude Code through the local bridge (lib/anthropic_bridge.mjs), as the product does when Claude Code is installed (GLM-5.3-flash: 14/24 real issues that way, 8/25 in the step agent; pipeline survey 2026-10-16), and Sonnet with the person's own login (a dispatched rung, no in-session delegation). glm-5.3 is not a cheap model here (its profile stays for pricing and as an optional test writer): a failed glm-5.3 try cost about what Opus spends on the whole task (ct-series-v5 sqlglot: $1.31 vs $1.62), so it cannot save money. cached_input_per_mtok: z.ai bills input served from its cache at a fifth (docs.z.ai pricing, 2026-10-28); General Compute reports no cached tokens. GLM: no reasoning_effort (z.ai read "high" as near-minimal thinking: 74 vs 724 reasoning tokens, 2026-10-28); thinking.clear_thinking=false keeps its reasoning across tool calls. Sampling: every cheap model at the vendor's temperature 1.0 (top_p 1.0 gpt-oss, 0.95 minimax/gemma); gpt-oss at reasoning_effort high (474 vs 156 reasoning tokens at General Compute's default); General Compute's own default is greedy for gpt-oss and gemma (2026-10-28).
